label: Pinion Smart.Shift
description: Shows the current gear and battery level of a Pinion Smart.Shift gearbox as Karoo data fields, plus a split 3s cadence and gear field, with a low-battery alert at 20, 10 and 5 %. Unofficial: not affiliated with Pinion or Hammerhead. Built on Tim Angus's reverse engineering of the Smart.Shift Bluetooth protocol.
releaseNotes: New field "3s Cad + Gear": 3 second cadence and the Pinion gear side by side in one cell, so a 2x2 page can show speed, power, heart rate, cadence and gear.
